question.text: What is the current status of the transaction charge framework that earlier allowed AMCs to deduct charges from investor subscriptions and pay distributors?

answer.text: It is still active with charges deducted from each large subscription
The charge amounts have been increased for new investors
SEBI withdrew the transaction charge framework in August 2025
It has been made optional for AMCs to implement

explanation.text: The Logic: The Series V-A workbook records that SEBI recently withdrew upfront commission and transaction-charge benefits, and that the August 2025 circular specifically withdrew the transaction-charges framework. Prior investor-borne transaction charges paid through subscriptions no longer apply under the current framework. The Trap: Options A, B, and D all treat the framework as still operational in some form. The November 2025 workbook explicitly states the framework has been withdrawn, so any claim that it is active, increased, or optional is incorrect. Note: With investor-borne transaction charges removed, distributor compensation runs through trail commission embedded in the TER. Always rely on the latest SEBI circular for exact charge components and amounts.
